name: 02119 · Roxbury, MA
findings: ZIP 02119 (Roxbury) has 211 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02119 (Roxbury) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
